mentions.name: hack-soc
mentions.description: A SystemVerilog implementation of the Nand2Tetris part 1 Hack computer running on an FPGA, extended into a toy SoC, with an assembler and UART loader written in Rust; a UART FSM that replaces the program in ROM is still to be written.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I also implemented Nand2Tetris part 1 in SystemVerilog, have it running on an FPGA and almost completed extending as a toy SoC. I wrote the assembler and UART loader in Rust, but I still need to write the UART FSM that replaces the program in "ROM".

https://github.com/MSamman/hack-soc
mentions.author: arrhythmic
